clock: It is {label}. Time only moves when you act: each build takes a season (one quarter of a year).
ffYear: Pressing this will fast-forward the timeline by 1 year. Defences keep growing while you wait, but so does the sea.
ffEvent: Pressing this skips {quarters} seasons, to just before the {storm}. Use it once your defences are in place.
ffEventNone: There is no storm left to skip to.
outlookTrack: The years from 2025 to 2050. Each mark is a storm: a wide band far out, narrowing to an exact season as it comes.
readiness: Ready {pct}%: your defences would stop {pct}% of the {storm}'s damage if it hit now, and {saved} of the {total} homes in its path would stand ({stars} stars). Build where the map turns red to raise it.
readinessNone: All three storms are behind you.
sea: Sea level rise since 2025: {cm} cm. It never stops, so every later storm is a little stronger.
coin: Your Coin: {coin}. Spend it on defences. Your city earns {income} Coin a season, collecting in the jar below.
jar: The jar holds {amount} Coin of your city's income. Tap to bank it. Free: no time passes.
housesCounter: Houses saved is your score: each storm's stars come from the share of homes in its path that stay standing. {standing} of {total} stand now.
fieldGuide: Your Field Guide: {found} of {species} creatures spotted, and {notes} of Maya's notes. Tap the creatures on the board to collect them.
riskToggle: Show risk (R): tints red the tiles the next storm will hit hardest, from five seasons out. Turn it off to see the map plain.
mayaToggle: Maya (M): turns her tips on or off. The red warning stays either way.
mayaDismiss: Closes Maya's tip. Esc does the same.
getReady: Optional jobs that help against the next storm. Each pays Coin the moment it is done; none of them is required.
back: Leaves this level and goes back to the menu.
streetMap: Shows or hides the real Panjim street map under the tiles.
streetMapOpacity: How strongly the street map shows through: {pct}%.
resilience: Resilience: how well the city is holding up overall. Storms that get through lower it.
biodiversity: Biodiversity: the life your nature defences bring back. Mangroves, dunes and khazans raise it.
carbon: Carbon: what the city stores (plus) or emits (minus). Mangroves and dunes store it; concrete emits it.
food: Food: khazans and mangroves feed the city; homes eat. Below zero, the city buys its food in.
population: Population: the people living in the city's homes.
income: Coin your city earns each season.
collapse: Shrinks this panel to a small strip. Tap the strip to open it again.
previewToggle: Shows where the coming storm would hit, as it stands now.
hazardIncoming: Which storm is coming, and how many turns until it does.
buildUnaffordable: {name}: {what} Costs {cost} Coin{time}. You have {coin} Coin: not enough yet.

buildWhat.dune: a sand bank that soaks up a cyclone's surge on the beach. It grows stronger for two years.
buildWhat.sandy_vegetation: pandanus and beach creepers whose roots hold the sand when the wind gets up.
buildWhat.beachside_resort: earns Coin, but weakens the beach against storms.
buildWhat.house: a home for more people. It pays Coin but needs food.
buildWhat.seawall: a concrete wall against the surge. Strong at once, but it absorbs no water and fails outright if a storm is bigger than it.
buildWhat.mangrove: slows a surge or a flood before it reaches the houses, and feeds the creek. It takes about five years to grow.
buildWhat.khazan: a bunded field and sluice that stores floodwater and grows rice and prawns.
buildWhat.small_dam: holds back river water and earns Coin, until a flood is too big for it.
buildWhat.sand_mining: earns Coin fast, but strips the river bed and makes floods worse.
buildWhat.yacht: a luxury. It does nothing for the city.
buildWhat.breakwater: a rock barrier offshore that breaks a cyclone's waves before they reach the beach.

builtInfo: What is built here, and what it adds to the city.
